experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Here we compare mass spectrometry-based proteome analyses of Metformin-treated SiHa cells (previously deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium with data set identifier PXC011095) with proteome analyses of SiHa cells transfected with si16E6/E7 or control siRNA (siCtrl-1) and grown for 72 hours to evaluate differences in the cell cycle regulation of HPV-positive cancer cells upon E6/E7 repression by Metformin or siE6/E7.
